question: How many orders?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {ORDMAS} WHERE CANCEL IS NULL OR CANCEL <> 'T'

question: How many orders for NEXT?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {ORDMAS} o JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER WHERE b.BUYERNAME = 'NEXT' AND (o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T')

question: total order quantity
sql: SELECT SUM(OQTY) FROM {ORDMAS} WHERE CANCEL IS NULL OR CANCEL <> 'T'

question: average order quantity
sql: SELECT AVG(OQTY) FROM {ORDMAS} WHERE CANCEL IS NULL OR CANCEL <> 'T'

question: Buyer wise order quantity
sql: SELECT b.BUYERNAME, SUM(o.OQTY) FROM {ORDMAS} o LEFT JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER WHERE o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T' GROUP BY b.BUYERNAME

question: top 1 buyers by quantity
sql: SELECT b.BUYERNAME, SUM(o.OQTY) q FROM {ORDMAS} o JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER WHERE o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T' GROUP BY b.BUYERNAME ORDER BY q DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
sql_sqlite: SELECT b.BUYERNAME, SUM(o.OQTY) q FROM {ORDMAS} o JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER WHERE o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T' GROUP BY b.BUYERNAME ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 1

question: size wise quantity for order PK/26-27/S/9001
sql: SELECT z.SIZES, SUM(s.RQTY) FROM {ORDSIZE} s JOIN {ORDMAS} o ON o.ORDMASID = s.ORDMASID JOIN {SIZE_MAS} z ON z.SIZE_MASID = s.GSIZE WHERE o.DOCID = 'PK/26-27/S/9001' GROUP BY z.SIZES

question: size wise quantity
sql: SELECT z.SIZES, SUM(s.RQTY) FROM {ORDSIZE} s JOIN {ORDMAS} o ON o.ORDMASID = s.ORDMASID JOIN {SIZE_MAS} z ON z.SIZE_MASID = s.GSIZE WHERE o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T' GROUP BY z.SIZES

question: colour wise quantity for NEXT
sql: SELECT c.COLOR, SUM(l.ORDQTY) FROM {ORDSTYLE} l JOIN {ORDMAS} o ON o.ORDMASID = l.ORDMASID JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER JOIN {COLORMAS} c ON c.COLORMASID = l.COMBO WHERE b.BUYERNAME = 'NEXT' AND (o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T') GROUP BY c.COLOR

question: colour wise number of orders
sql: SELECT c.COLOR, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDMASID) FROM {ORDSTYLE} l JOIN {ORDMAS} o ON o.ORDMASID = l.ORDMASID JOIN {COLORMAS} c ON c.COLORMASID = l.COMBO WHERE o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T' GROUP BY c.COLOR

question: monthly order quantity
sql: SELECT {MONTH(ODATE)}, SUM(OQTY) FROM {ORDMAS} WHERE CANCEL IS NULL OR CANCEL <> 'T' GROUP BY {MONTH(ODATE)}

question: orders with quantity more than 460
sql: SELECT DOCID FROM {ORDMAS} WHERE OQTY > 460 AND (CANCEL IS NULL OR CANCEL <> 'T')

question: which buyer has order PK/26-27/S/9003
sql: SELECT b.BUYERNAME FROM {ORDMAS} o JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER WHERE o.DOCID = 'PK/26-27/S/9003'

question: size wise quantity for order {p_order}

params.p_order: SELECT DOCID FROM {ORDMAS} WHERE CANCEL IS NULL OR CANCEL <> 'T' ORDER BY ORDMASID DESC

sql: SELECT z.SIZES, SUM(s.RQTY) FROM {ORDSIZE} s JOIN {ORDMAS} o ON o.ORDMASID = s.ORDMASID JOIN {SIZE_MAS} z ON z.SIZE_MASID = s.GSIZE WHERE o.DOCID = :p_order GROUP BY z.SIZES

question: orders NEXT ZARA
sql: SELECT o.DOCID FROM {ORDMAS} o JOIN {BUYMAS} b ON b.BUYMASID = o.BUYER WHERE b.BUYERNAME IN ('NEXT', 'ZARA') AND (o.CANCEL IS NULL OR o.CANCEL <> 'T')
